title: Ethereal Ethiopian Cabbage Wot
description: A sour, flaky, and romantic Ethiopian dish featuring canola oil and nigiri-shaping.
instructions: Heat canola oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add chopped cabbage and cook until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle teff flour over the cabbage mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Add vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, shape nigiri into small balls and flatten slightly.
To serve, place a portion of the cabbage wot on each nigiri piece.
Garnish with a sprinkle of bergamot powder and serve immediately.
